visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a gray quilted vest over a dark green long-sleeved shirt and a blue baseball cap sits on a brown carved wooden sofa with orange patterned cushions. He is looking at a smartphone in his hands with a neutral facial expression. The indoor setting features a plain white wall and traditional furniture under bright, even lighting. (2) The scene cuts as the man looks up at the camera, gesturing with his phone while speaking with an animated, smiling expression. Close-up shots show his hands holding a smartphone with a yellow case, displaying a call interface with an avatar of an older man. (3) The perspective shifts to an older man standing outside a wooden door with a metallic door knocker. He is wearing glasses, a plaid shirt, and a dark cap, holding a smartphone to his ear and looking slightly frustrated. A red banner with black calligraphy is visible on the wall next to the door. (4) Back inside, the man sits on the sofa and later stands up to move towards the front door. He presents the door area where a large red 'Fu' character banner hangs. He gestures towards the camera with a confident smile, wearing a bead bracelet on his right wrist. (5) A montage of close-up shots displays the Arpha X6 smart lock. Hands are shown interacting with the device, demonstrating palm vein scanning and face recognition. The lock has a sleek black finish with a built-in screen. The man appears in various screen-in-screen overlays, laughing and gesturing towards the product's interface.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male voice begins speaking in a friendly and animated tone with clear Traditional Chinese articulation. A bright, mid-tempo electronic BGM with a strong rhythmic pulse enters immediately. A digital 'ding' and a phone vibration SFX are heard early on. (2) The speaker's pitch variability is high as he recounts a humorous story. A cartoonish 'pop' SFX accompanies a visual cut. The BGM maintains a steady, upbeat energy with synthesizers and crisp electronic drums. (3) A second male voice, sounding older, is heard through a telephone filter with slightly muffled acoustics and low frequency response. The primary speaker continues with high vocal arousal and laughter in the background. (4) Technical SFX such as 'whooshes' and high-pitched UI chimes are layered in as the product features are described. The vocal density increases with a fast speech rate. The music swells slightly during transitions to emphasize excitement. (5) The audio concludes with a energetic closing statement from the main speaker. The BGM remains consistent until the very end, accompanied by a final bright 'stinger' SFX and a mechanical latch sound effect.
